page_title: RBL 4-1 DOR | RB Leipzig v Dortmund 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' What a miss! The corner finds Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
90' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
88' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) replaces Lois Openda.
88' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) blazes well wide of the right post.
88' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Xaver Schlager will be replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
87' Substitution. Amadou Haidara is replaced by Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
85' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
84' The corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is hurriedly cleared.
84' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) takes the corner with a short pass.
82' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Gregor Kobel easily deals with the threat.

80' 4 - 1 Goal! Benjamin Henrichs displays great vision and sends a pass to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 4:1.
78' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

77' David Raum (RB Leipzig) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Corner kick. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity.
76' It's like he was asking for a caution. Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) receives a yellow card.
75' David Raum (RB Leipzig) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.
74' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tested Gregor Kobel with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved. RB Leipzig earn a corner.
74' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

73' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
71' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Julian Ryerson is replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund).
70' Substitution. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) on for Benjamin Sesko.

70' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
68' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
68' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
66' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) sends the corner into the box, but Peter Gulacsi intercepts it and averts the threat.
66' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Dortmund will take a corner.

66' Peter Gulacsi pulls off a fantastic save! Marco Reus (Dortmund) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out. Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
65' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
65' The attendance for today's match is 47069.
64' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Gregor Kobel.
63' A substitution has been made. Salih Ozcan goes off and Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) comes on.
61' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
60' The ball is cleared after Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
56' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
56' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

56' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' Dortmund keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
53' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
51' Marco Rose is forced to make a change. Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is unable to continue due to injury, Benjamin Henrichs comes on.
51' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Niklas Sule.
50' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Peter Gulacsi pulls off a great save to deny Julian Ryerson (Dortmund), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
46' 3 - 1 It's 3:1! Lois Openda feeds Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
46' Edin Terzic makes a half-time substitution. Marco Reus comes on in place of Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
46' The whistle blows and Deniz Aytekin starts the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.

45+2' 2 - 1 The goalkeeper makes a save but the ball rebounds off him out to Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). He finds himself some space inside the penalty area and unleashes an unstoppable shot which bounces in off the crossbar. A magnificent goal!

45+2' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the top right corner. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Gregor Kobel and his brilliant save.
45+2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

45+1' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+1' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) receives the ball from David Raum and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.

43' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
41' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) behaves unsportingly. Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
37' Unsporting behaviour by Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig). The referee is firm and issues Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) a deserved yellow card.

36' What a chance that is! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!

34' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
30' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Deniz Aytekin changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
30' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.

29' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. RB Leipzig are awarded a penalty.
27' 3:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.

24' No offside! Referee Deniz Aytekin points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The RB Leipzig players celebrate. Goal! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper low inside the middle of the net. 1:1.
23' The RB Leipzig players joy may have been justified, because referee Deniz Aytekin is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
23' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 0:1.
18' Julian Brandt sends over an inswinging corner and Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just over the bar.
18' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is about to take a corner kick.

18' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Peter Gulacsi pulls off an easy save. The referee signals a corner kick to Dortmund.
15' Lois Openda passes to Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes well wide of the left post.
13' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
11' The corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared away by the defence.
10' Peter Gulacsi makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) after a cross from the side. Dortmund win a corner.
10' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Lois Openda.
9' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) steps up to send the ball in.
8' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
6' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
4' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) brought his opponent down.
2' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) sees the run of Lois Openda and tries to slip the ball to him, but Gregor Kobel sees the danger and gathers.

RB Leipzig will kick-off.
